##Apply the "chunking" method to break down the sentence structure  
Break the document into three logical chunks: (1) identity and role (Muhammad Ayub Sheikh is a politician and member of NA), (2) election details (year, constituency, party, vote count), and (3) opponent and result. Review each chunk separately and then reassemble them to reinforce retention through active recall.
